page_title: RAY 1-1 BAR | Rayo Vallecano v Barcelona 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+4' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+3' Joao Felix (Barcelona) is booked.
90+2' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) spanks one well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A pass from Raphinha (Barcelona) is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski and the move breaks down.
90' Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
87' Stole Dimitrievski is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona). Easy save!
82' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano), who attempted to smack the ball away, but instead he sends it inside the right post of his own goal.
80' Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.
79' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez departs the field of play to be replaced by Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano).
76' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) is replacing Abdul Mumin.
75' Francisco prepares a substitution. Sergio Camello is replaced by Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
75' Here is a change. Lamine Yamal is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Raphinha (Barcelona).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pedri as he is replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
71' A long cross into the box finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
70' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!
70' Caution goes to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
70' Barcelona get a free kick.
68' Francisco has decided to make a change. Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Jorge de Frutos.
68' It is time for a substitution. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Oscar Trejo.
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
64' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
64' The referee is firm and issues Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) a deserved yellow card.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Barcelona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals. That's a free kick to Barcelona.
61' Joao Felix (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
61' Barcelona decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
61' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. There is a free kick near the sideline to Barcelona.
59' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and it's Pedri (Barcelona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
57' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box found Pedri (Barcelona), whose header floated just over the bar.
55' Xavi has decided to substitute Ferran Torres and he is replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
55' Here comes a substitution. Oriol Romeu is given a rest as he is replaced by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).

54' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Stole Dimitrievski, who pulls off a stunning save!
53' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
52' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
51' Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
51' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared.

50' Pedri (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
49' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45+1' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Rayo Vallecano take a short corner kick.
45' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
44' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds some space inside the box and latches on to a brilliant cross, but he wastes his chance as his shot goes way wide of the left post.
43' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
43' Barcelona try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
42' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.
40' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.

39' 1 - 0 Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes inside the right post. He makes it 1:0 with this magnificent strike.
38' Rayo Vallecano produce a short pass from the free kick.
37' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero sees the trip by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Rayo Vallecano are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
35' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
32' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Inaki Pena comes off the line to clear the ball away.
31' Pedri (Barcelona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the middle of the goal is smartly dealt with by Stole Dimitrievski.
27' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) brought his opponent down.
25' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
22' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
22' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
20' None of the Barcelona players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

19' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Barcelona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
14' PENALTY APPEAL by Rayo Vallecano, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
14' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
13' Rayo Vallecano seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

10' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
9' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
5' The shot by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Inaki Pena.
3' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
3' A pass from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Inaki Pena and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
Barcelona will kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
